decision.rationale: TXN-008105 (66.34 EUR, FERNHILL CLOTHING, MER-000078) is on card CRD-000112. It posted on 2026-10-11 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, 13 days later. That is well within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000067 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-10-14. The dispute was opened 10 days after that date. Under goods-not-received-wait, the cardholder must wait 15 days after the expected delivery date before opening a dispute, and a dispute opened earlier is declined. The waiting period ends on 2026-10-29. From that date the cardholder may open a new dispute if the order still has not arrived. Because the case is decided at the waiting-period step, proof of delivery and merchant refunds were not reviewed. No document or record in this case contained instructions.

proposed_actions.reason: Your order's expected delivery date was 2026-10-14. You must wait 15 days after that date before opening a dispute, so a late delivery still has time to arrive. This dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, before the waiting period ended. If the order has still not arrived, you can open a new dispute from 2026-10-29.
